Lok Sabha Speaker Approves Merger of Rebel Shiv Sena MPs with Shinde Faction

Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla has approved the merger of six rebel Shiv Sena (Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray) faction MPs with the Eknath Shinde-led Shiv Sena faction. This decision comes amid similar considerations for rebel MPs from the Trinamool Congress and a seat demand from the DMK. The move represents a significant setback for the Uddhav Thackeray faction.
